payload.claim: The CHECK-constraint test only inserts rows with a concrete status; it never inserts a `batches` row with `status` omitted (NULL), which the schema comment (ledger.py:33) states is deliberately legal for a still-running batch. Adding `NOT NULL` to the `status` column definition would keep this test passing (every value it inserts is non-NULL) while breaking the documented in-flight-batch case that SA-0049 will rely on.
